desert-to-delta.title: The Desert to Delta
desert-to-delta.description: Journey from the rust-red dunes of Sossusvlei through Etosha's legendary waterholes to the emerald channels of the Okavango Delta. This cross-border route captures the full spectrum of Southern Africa's desert-to-wetland transformation.
highlights: Climb the iconic Dune 45 at sunrise in Sossusvlei
Game drive around Etosha's floodlit waterholes at dusk
Cross into Botswana via the lush Caprivi Strip
Mokoro safari through the Okavango Delta channels
Sunset cruise on the Chobe River among elephant herds

days.title: Windhoek & Sossusvlei
days.narrative: Collect your 4×4 in Windhoek and head south into the Namib Desert. Arrive at Sossusvlei for a pre-dawn climb of Dune 45 and explore the surreal white clay pan of Deadvlei with its ancient camelthorn skeletons.

days.title: Swakopmund & Skeleton Coast
days.narrative: Drive through the Gaub and Kuiseb passes to the Atlantic coast. Enjoy sandboarding, quad biking, or a catamaran cruise among dolphins and seals at Walvis Bay.

days.title: Damaraland & Etosha
days.narrative: Track desert-adapted elephants in Damaraland and visit UNESCO-listed rock engravings at Twyfelfontein. Enter Etosha for world-class game viewing at its famous waterholes — rhino, elephant, and lion sightings are common.

days.title: Caprivi Strip
days.narrative: Head north into the tropical Zambezi region — a lush contrast to the desert south. Birding, river cruises, and hippo pods await along the Kavango River.

days.title: Chobe National Park
days.narrative: Cross the border into Botswana. Chobe is home to Africa's largest elephant population. Afternoon boat cruises offer intimate wildlife encounters at water level.

days.title: Okavango Delta
days.narrative: Fly or drive to Maun and enter the Delta. Glide through papyrus channels in a traditional mokoro, then enjoy guided bush walks and 4×4 game drives in Moremi.

coastal-explorer.title: The Coastal Explorer
coastal-explorer.description: From Cape Town's Table Mountain along the Garden Route and Wild Coast to Mozambique's Bazaruto Archipelago — the ultimate Indian Ocean adventure combining mountains, forests, and tropical islands.
highlights: Table Mountain cable car and Cape Winelands tasting
Garden Route forests, lagoons, and Storms River Mouth
iSimangaliso Wetland Park — UNESCO World Heritage
Maputo's vibrant markets and peri-peri seafood
Dhow sailing and snorkelling in the Bazaruto Archipelago

days.title: Cape Town & Peninsula
days.narrative: Explore Table Mountain, the V&A Waterfront, and the Cape Peninsula — penguins at Boulders Beach, Chapman's Peak drive, and Cape Point where two oceans meet.

days.title: Garden Route
days.narrative: Whale watching in Hermanus, canopy tours in Tsitsikamma, and the dramatic Knysna Heads. Ancient forests and secluded beaches define this legendary coastal drive.

days.title: Wild Coast & Durban
days.narrative: Trace the rugged Eastern Cape coastline through traditional Xhosa villages. Continue to Durban for its Indian-influenced cuisine and golden beaches.

days.title: Kosi Bay & Maputo
days.narrative: Snorkel the coral reefs of Kosi Bay and cross into Mozambique. Explore Maputo's art deco architecture and feast on tiger prawns at the fish market.

days.title: Vilanculos & Bazaruto
days.narrative: Speedboat to the Bazaruto Archipelago. Snorkel pristine reefs, spot dugongs, and sail into the sunset on a traditional dhow.

falls-beyond.title: The Falls & Beyond
falls-beyond.description: Experience the thunder of Victoria Falls, walk among leopards in South Luangwa, track elephants in Hwange, and cruise the Chobe River — the quintessential Zambezi basin safari circuit.
highlights: Helicopter "Flight of Angels" over Victoria Falls
Walking safari in the birthplace of the genre — South Luangwa
Devil's Pool swim at the edge of the falls (seasonal)
Hwange's massive elephant herds at waterholes
Chobe sunset river cruise among hippos and crocs

days.title: Livingstone & Victoria Falls
days.narrative: Witness the world's largest sheet of falling water from the Zambian side. Optional bungee, white-water rafting, or helicopter flight over the "Smoke That Thunders".

days.title: South Luangwa
days.narrative: Fly to Mfuwe for the ultimate walking safari experience. South Luangwa has one of Africa's highest leopard densities and exceptional night drives.

days.title: Hwange & Matobo
days.narrative: Cross into Zimbabwe. Hwange's waterholes attract hundreds of elephants. Visit Matobo Hills for rhino tracking and ancient San rock art.

days.title: Chobe River
days.narrative: Enter Botswana for a finale on the Chobe River. Boat cruises at sunset reveal elephant herds swimming between islands.

kingdom-circuit.title: The Kingdom Circuit
kingdom-circuit.description: A compact highland adventure through two mountain kingdoms — pony trekking in Lesotho, royal game reserves in Eswatini, and a Big Five finale in Kruger National Park.
highlights: Ascend the legendary Sani Pass into the "Kingdom in the Sky"
Pony trekking through Lesotho's highland villages
Rhino tracking on foot in Mkhaya Game Reserve
Swazi cultural village and traditional dance at Mantenga
Big Five game drive in Kruger National Park

days.title: Sani Pass & Malealea
days.narrative: Cross from South Africa into Lesotho via the dramatic Sani Pass. Pony trek through remote highland villages and overnight in a traditional lodge.

days.title: Afriski & Katse Dam
days.narrative: Visit Africa's only ski resort (winter) or hike the surrounding peaks. Marvel at the engineering feat of Katse Dam nestled in the mountains.

days.title: Eswatini Kingdom
days.narrative: Enter the Kingdom of Eswatini. Track rhinos on foot in Mkhaya, visit the Mantenga cultural village, and spot lions in Hlane Royal National Park.

days.title: Kruger National Park
days.narrative: Cross back into South Africa for a Big Five finale. Full-day game drives in Kruger's central region around Satara and Orpen.

lake-mountain.title: Lake & Mountain
lake-mountain.description: Snorkel among a thousand cichlid species in Lake Malawi, summit Mount Mulanje's peaks, safari along the Shire River, and explore Mozambique's UNESCO-listed Ilha de Moçambique.
highlights: Snorkelling with endemic cichlids at Cape Maclear
Multi-day trek on Mount Mulanje — the "Island in the Sky"
Boat safari among elephants on the Shire River
Explore the historic stone town of Ilha de Moçambique

days.title: Lake Malawi
days.narrative: Arrive at the "Lake of Stars". Snorkel among hundreds of colourful cichlid species, kayak to Domwe Island, and enjoy sunset dhow cruises.

days.title: Mount Mulanje
days.narrative: Trek through tea estates to the base of Mulanje. Hike to Chambe Basin and optionally summit Sapitwa Peak (3,002m) — the highest point in the region.

days.title: Liwonde National Park
days.narrative: Boat safari on the Shire River among dense elephant and hippo populations. Optional rhino tracking in the sanctuary.

days.title: Ilha de Moçambique
days.narrative: Cross into Mozambique and fly or drive to the coast. Explore the UNESCO World Heritage island — crumbling Portuguese forts, dhow harbour, and pristine reefs.

grand-safari.title: The Grand Safari
grand-safari.description: The definitive three-country Southern African safari. From Kruger's Big Five through Namibia's desert wonders to Botswana's pristine Okavango Delta — the journey of a lifetime.
highlights: Big Five safari in Kruger and Sabi Sands
Skeleton Coast fly-in and seal colony visit
Mokoro and walking safari in the Okavango Delta

days.title: Kruger National Park
days.narrative: Begin in South Africa's flagship reserve. Expert-guided game drives in search of the Big Five, with optional luxury extension into Sabi Sands for leopard encounters.

days.title: Etosha & Damaraland
days.narrative: Fly or drive to Namibia. Game drives around Etosha's vast salt pan and track rare desert-adapted elephants and rhinos on foot in Damaraland.

days.title: Skeleton Coast & Sossusvlei
days.narrative: Explore the haunting Skeleton Coast by scenic flight. Climb the towering dunes of Sossusvlei and discover the ancient dead trees of Deadvlei.

days.title: Swakopmund & Walvis Bay
days.narrative: Coastal adventure interlude — sandboarding, kayaking with seals, and fresh Atlantic oysters in Namibia's adventure capital.

days.title: Caprivi & Chobe
days.narrative: Head north through the lush Caprivi into Botswana. Chobe's elephant herds gather along the riverfront in their hundreds.

days.title: Okavango Delta & Moremi
days.narrative: The grand finale in the Okavango Delta. Mokoro excursions, guided bush walks, and 4×4 drives in Moremi — Africa's predator capital.

namibia-essentials.title: Namibia Essentials
namibia-essentials.description: The definitive Namibia loop — dunes, coast, Damaraland, and Etosha in under two weeks. Perfect for first-time visitors with a 4x4.

days.title: Windhoek to Sossusvlei
days.narrative: Collect your vehicle and drive south to the Namib. Pre-dawn entry for Dune 45 and the white clay pan of Deadvlei.

days.title: Coast & Swakopmund
days.narrative: Cross the Namib to the Atlantic. Kayak with seals, sandboard the dunes, and explore colonial Swakopmund.

days.title: Damaraland
days.narrative: Track desert-adapted elephants and visit UNESCO rock engravings among granite kopjes.

days.title: Etosha Safari
days.narrative: Game drive the park's waterholes — rhino, elephant, lion, and giraffe concentrations in dry season.

days.title: Return via Windhoek
days.narrative: Drive south through Otjiwarongo to Windhoek. Optional craft market and departure.
